subject: ArdentPulse — binding windows, MAP sequencing, and MSA/DPA dependencies
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@ardentpulsehealth.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ArdentPulse MAP draft + sequencing questions (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Samantha / ArdentPulse procurement team —

Thanks for the time on Friday. Attached is an initial mutual action plan (MAP) that stitches the evaluation milestones to contract deliverables so we can be explicit about what needs to be done by each party to reach signature and activation. High-level asks from our side so we can lock the close window: 

1) Confirm the target "binding window" (your preferred date range to execute MSA + DPA + order form). We proposed 2026-03-22 to 2026-03-26 in the attached MAP as a conservative target.
2) Tell us whether your legal team needs a separate schedule for DPA-specific exhibits (we can split or keep it consolidated).
3) Any procurement-only items (PO process, internal approvers, finance lead) we should include on the MAP? If you can share a primary procurement contact, we'll add them to the lane.

Key dependencies we identified (summary):
- Redwood: finalize order form pricing and deliverable list (we can provide a clean v3 by EOD Thurs).
- ArdentPulse: confirm DPA redline ownership (legal or security?) and estimated redline turn time.
- Both: evaluation acceptance criteria sign-off (we've attached a short checklist).

Attached: ArdentPulse_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP with lanes), orderform-draft-v3.docx (pricing placeholders).

If you prefer a short 30-min working session to walk the MAP with your legal and procurement, I can host Wed or Thu afternoon PST.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: ArdentPulse_MAP_v1.2.xlsx] [Attachment: orderform-draft-v3.docx]

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP. Quick answers inline:

1) Binding window: Prefer the week of 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-19 if possible; our finance approver is out the last week of March.
2) DPA exhibits: Our security team prefers a separate DPA exhibits file so it's easier to version independently.
3) Procurement contact: looping Tom Becker (procurement lead) here — he owns PO timing and internal approvers.

Tom / Procurement: can you confirm expected PO lead time once the order form is final? Also, do we need a vendor packet for SOW-style deliverables?

Happy to do a 30-min sync Thu 2/12 at 11:00 PST if that works for Redwood legal to cover redlines.

Cheers,

Marissa / Laura —

Quick internal note after Samantha's replies:

- Binding window shift to week of 3/15 is fine. We should aim to have our clean order form and pricing locked by 3/5 to allow ArdentPulse a 10-business-day review.
- Laura: if ArdentPulse wants a separate DPA exhibits file, we'll publish DPA_v1 and keep a redline PDF for their security. Legal ETA for initial redlines: 2 business days after Thu 2/12 sync (so target 2/16).
- Rishi: can you prepare the security evidence bundle (SOC 2 excerpt + data flow diagram + retention policy) for the call? Attach as a stub for the thread.

- 2/13: Redwood finalizes orderform v3 with pricing (= Marissa/Karthik)
- 2/16: Redwood legal provides DPA initial redlines and security evidence bundle (= Laura/Rishi)

I'll attach a minimal checklist we can paste into the MAP.

- Karthik

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@ardentpulsehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@ardentpulsehealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ArdentPulse MAP draft + sequencing questions (DPA redlines + timeline)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks for confirming the week-of request. We're aligned to meet that. A few legal notes ahead of the call:

1) Because you prefer a separate DPA exhibits file, we'll produce DPA_v1 (main DPA) and DPA_exhibits_v1 (data processing specifics). We're planning to send redlines within 48 hours after the sync.
2) Two items to flag that could affect the binding window if there is pushback:
   - Data residency clause: if ArdentPulse requires EU-only residency for any production data, that will add vendor ops review and push signature ~2–3 weeks. Please confirm there is no region-specific restriction.
   - Indemnity limits: our standard cap is 3x fees per year; if your legal requests higher, we will need escrows or SLA credits which will take time to negotiate.
3) Tom — for PO timing, if ArdentPulse can commit to Net30 post-signature, we've seen purchase order lead times reduce to 5–7 business days (typical). If your finance requires purchase in a specific fiscal quarter, we should note that in the MAP.

Attachments: DPA_redlines_20260212.pdf (redline placeholders), and a short "MAP checklist" that maps who owns each lane on signature day.

I will join the Thu 2/12 11:00 PST call and plan to circulate the PDF redlines immediately after.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DPA_redlines_20260212.pdf]

Samantha / Tom —

Great sync today — appreciate the clarity. Confirming agreed next steps and dates for the MAP lanes (copied to the MAP for visibility):

- 2/17 by EOD (Redwood): final orderform v3 to Tom (Marissa/Karthik). [Attachment: orderform-draft-v3.docx sent]
- 2/18 (ArdentPulse): procurement confirmation on PO process and required vendor packet fields (Tom)
- 2/19 (Joint): sign-off on evaluation acceptance criteria (Samantha + Marissa)
- 2/16–2/20 (Redwood Legal): finalize DPA exhibits and circulate executed redline PDF (Laura) — note: Laura produced initial redlines during the call; final redlines will reflect today's conversation.
- 3/15–3/19: target binding window (MSA + DPA countersigned; order form executed, PO received).

Open items we flagged that could shift the window: data residency ask, or material change to indemnity cap. If either shows up we will re-run the MAP lanes and update the timeline.

Next immediate action: Tom, please confirm whether Net30 is acceptable or if ArdentPulse needs vendor payment terms tied to a specific fiscal cutoff. If Net30 is OK, we'll plan order placement and onboarding to start the week after signature.

I'll upload the updated MAP and send the DocuSign link as soon as the order form is final. HubSpot deal link below for anyone who wants to add notes.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/record/AP-2026-089
DocuSign placeholder: will be sent after orderform finalization.
